QM.title: Tahúres
QM.settings.startDice.name: Starting Dice
QM.settings.onesWild.name: Rule: 1s are wild
QM.settings.onesWild.hint: If checked, 1s will count as any value (except in Palifico rounds).
QM.settings.palifico.name: 'Palifico' Rule
QM.settings.palifico.hint: If checked, when a player is down to 1 die, the bet value cannot be changed.
QM.select.title: Tahúres – Participants
QM.notify.twoTokensNeeded: You need at least two actor tokens on the scene to play.
QM.notify.oneGmOnly: Only one actor can be assigned to the Game Master.
QM.notify.invalidBet: Invalid bet. It must be higher than the previous one.
QM.chat.noWinner: No players left! The game ends in a draw.
QM.chat.spotOnSuccess: EXACT MATCH! Everyone else loses one die.
QM.chat.spotOnFail: WRONG! They lose 2 dice for the attempt.
QM.chat.initiativeInstructions: Each player rolls 1d20 to see who starts:
QM.chat.initiativeTie: Tie! The tied players roll again:
QM.chat.initiativeWinner: {name} gets the highest roll and starts the game!
QM.chat.palificoAnnounce: A player is down to one die! This round is PALIFICO!
QM.gmTray.title: GM's View - All Rolls
QM.gm.dieRemoved: The GM removed one die from {name}.
QM.gm.gameEndedManually: The game was ended manually by the GM.
QM.tray.title: Dice Tray
QM.settings.palificoMode.name: Palifico: variant
QM.settings.palificoMode.hint: House: the whole table plays palifico as soon as anyone has 1 die. Classic: only the round opened by a player with 1 die, once per player.
QM.settings.spotOn.name: Spot On: variant
QM.settings.spotOn.hint: House: on a hit everyone else loses 1 die; on a miss you lose 2. Classic: on a hit you gain 1 die; on a miss you lose 1.
QM.settings.ante.name: Pot ante
QM.settings.ante.hint: Each player puts in this amount; the winner takes the pot. 0 = no money.
QM.settings.ante.noPath: Set the money path in the module settings to enable betting.
QM.settings.currencyPath.name: Actor money path
QM.settings.currencyPath.hint: Numeric actor field used for stakes, e.g. system.coins.value. Empty = betting off. Actors without that field play for the house.
QM.chat.potKept: The pot ({pot}) stays on the table.
QM.phrase.farolera.bet: Let's see who dares call me…
QM.phrase.farolera.lie: Sounds like a tall tale to me!
QM.phrase.cauta.lie: I don't trust that one bit.
QM.mia.noRoll: No roll: you haven't lifted the cup.
QM.mia.announceHint: Only rolls higher than the previous one are listed. The ★ marks your real roll: tell the truth or lie.
QM.mia.invalid: Invalid announcement: it must beat the previous one.
QM.mia.rules: Two dice under the cup: announce (or lie about) something higher than the last announcement, or doubt it. Mia (2-1) is the highest. Lives: {lives}.
QM.mia.accepts: accepts the announcement and rolls under the cup.
QM.mia.truth: They told the truth (or understated): the doubter loses.
QM.mia.livesHint: Each failed doubt costs one life (two if Mia was involved).
QM.settings.skin.name: Look (skin)
QM.settings.skin.hint: Visual setting of the game for the whole table.
